snippet.title: I Made FNAF, But It's 2D
snippet.description:
I Recreated FNAF in 2D. This was insane.

GAME (ANDROID): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jujuprodgames.fnaf2d
GAME (PC): https://jujuprodgames.itch.io/fnaf-2d
GAME (IOS): no (i would've uploaded 2069 lol)

-

-📄𝗗𝗘𝗦𝗖𝗥𝗜𝗣𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡📄-
With the movie having released and the games being ever so popular, let's recreate this classic horror game in 2D.
